name: Microsoft Whiteboard
description: Microsoft Whiteboard is a collaborative visual canvas integrated with Microsoft 365 and Teams, with current boards stored in OneDrive for Business and tenant controls spanning Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, and Entra.
agentUseSummary: Microsoft Whiteboard is unsupported for a general Relay connector. Microsoft's current public stable Graph reference does not publish a Whiteboard board, canvas, object, stroke, note, comment, or collaboration API. Tenant administrators have narrow migration and export cmdlets, and OneDrive storage does not make the proprietary board content a supported semantic interface.

capabilities.label: Open Whiteboard manually
capabilities.description: Provide a user-visible handoff to Microsoft Whiteboard without reading, creating, editing, exporting, sharing, or automating board content.

blocked.label: Connect without a supported public API
blocked.description: Microsoft does not publish a stable semantic Whiteboard content and collaboration API for a general delegated connector.

blocked.label: Read boards or canvas content
blocked.description: Boards, canvases, templates, frames, text, notes, shapes, strokes, images, links, reactions, comments, participants, activities, files, exports, and metadata remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Change boards or collaboration
blocked.description: Creating, editing, grouping, moving, drawing, erasing, commenting, reacting, presenting, exporting, importing, copying, deleting, restoring, or migrating boards is blocked.

blocked.label: Change sharing or tenant settings
blocked.description: Sharing links, meeting or channel tabs, permissions, ownership, tenant enablement, Teams policies, conditional access, OneDrive administration, roles, and app policies are blocked.

blocked.label: Bypass product controls
blocked.description: Proprietary OneDrive board-file parsing, WhiteboardAdmin tenant export, SharePoint admin elevation, arbitrary Graph, legacy service endpoints, scraping, browser automation, tokens, and private API inference are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unsupported
approvalProfiles.description: No Whiteboard action is enabled unless Microsoft publishes a stable delegated semantic API and its complete identity, board, content, collaboration, sharing, storage, revocation, and disconnect contract passes representative acceptance.

runtimeSupport.description: No Microsoft Whiteboard wrapper is mounted because no supported stable semantic board API is available for this generic connector.

providerSetup.blocker: Microsoft documents Whiteboard as a collaborative canvas whose current boards are stored in OneDrive for Business. Tenant availability and access depend on Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, Teams meeting and app policies, Entra enterprise applications, and conditional access. Sharing a board in a Teams meeting, chat, or channel can create organization-wide sharing links and meeting-participant permissions. The public WhiteboardAdmin PowerShell module is restricted to Global or SharePoint administrators and focuses on legacy Azure-board retrieval, migration mapping, tenant enumeration, and HTML export; OneDrive access may require Site Collection Administrator rights. The current public stable Microsoft Graph reference reviewed here does not define Whiteboard board or canvas resources and methods. Storage and privileged export are not a safe delegated semantic API.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep Whiteboard unavailable and provide only a manual handoff. Do not parse proprietary OneDrive board files, elevate SharePoint administrators, use WhiteboardAdmin exports, infer private APIs, or automate the web client. Re-evaluate only if Microsoft publishes a stable production API with documented delegated scopes for exact boards and supported canvas objects. Any future acceptance must verify tenant and board ownership, OneDrive storage, meeting and chat sharing links, internal and external participants, private content and images, live collaboration and concurrency, comments and reactions, exports, retention and eDiscovery, legacy migration, deletion and recovery, token revocation, disconnect, and cross-tenant denial before Connect is enabled.

evidence.supports: Whiteboard uses OneDrive for Business and requires tenant-wide Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Entra, and conditional-access configuration rather than a documented user content API.
Whiteboard meeting, chat, channel, and native-client sharing creates OneDrive-backed links with organization, participant, owner, guest, and external-user behavior.
WhiteboardAdmin is restricted to Global or SharePoint administrators and exposes tenant retrieval, migration, mapping, and HTML export, with elevated OneDrive access required for users' boards.

Microsoft states that the v1.0 Graph endpoint contains production API sets and directs developers to use documented resource and method reference; no Whiteboard content resource is present in the reviewed stable reference.
Microsoft Graph calls require explicitly documented versioned resources and permissions and Microsoft recommends v1.0 rather than beta for production applications.
